items.headline: Venables lauds Witten after Sooners shine in Oklahoma playcaller's debut
items.description: In his debut as Oklahoma's offensive playcaller, Jason Witten, a former NFL tight end who coached high school in Texas last year, engineered an impressive Sooners attack that throttled No. 25 Florida in a 23-7 victory Saturday to push them to 5-4.

items.headline: Cowboys' offensive production needs to step up
items.description: Todd Archer reports on how the Cowboys' offense needs to be better in order to stay in the playoff chase.

items.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones says paying coaches never been an issue
items.description: Defending comments he made earlier in the week, Cowboys owner and GM Jerry Jones said it's "ridiculous" to think he would let money stop him from hiring a head coach.

items.headline: NFL trade deadline grades: Deals for Jacoby Brissett, Jeffery Simmons, more
items.description: Wise move for the Ravens to add Jacoby Brissett? Did the Bears give up too much to go all-in with Jeffery Simmons? Let's evaluate eight trades before the deadline.
